---
title: "{title}"
format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    geometry:
      - margin=1.5cm
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{longtable}
        \usepackage{array}
        \usepackage{booktabs}
        \usepackage{pdflscape}
        \usepackage{ragged2e}
        \setlength{\LTleft}{0pt}
        \setlength{\LTright}{0pt}
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  csv: null
  caption: null
---

```{r}
#| results: asis

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dat <- read.csv(
  params$csv,
  check.names = FALSE
)

caption <- params$caption

# Print longtable
cat(
  kbl(
    dat,
    digits = 2,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    caption = caption,
    linesep = "",
    escape = TRUE
  ) |>
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("repeat_header"),
      font_size = 8,
      full_width = TRUE,
      position = "left"
    )
)

```
